war_declared.text: {my_faction} regrets that {enemy_faction} has left us no honourable road. I trust the council will remember who chose this.
Forgive me if I do not sound surprised. Some of us saw {enemy_faction} coming for a season, and some of us kept a ledger.
Lords of {my_faction}, I will draft the motion for the war chest myself, so no one can say we rushed into this. A sad necessity.
Let it be recorded that {my_faction} sought terms with {enemy_faction} in good faith. Their answer was a banner, and now a war.
{enemy_faction} will find that patience is a currency I hold in plenty. I hope they did not spend all of theirs on the first vote.

peace_made.text: {my_faction} has accepted terms with {faction}. The council will be asked to note who made the first gracious gesture.
A peace with {faction} is a fine thing, provided the ledger balances. I shall be checking the ink on every clause.
Good news for the roads: {my_faction} and {faction} are at peace. I am sure both sides will be pleased to hear it from me first.
{faction} has signed, and {my_faction} has signed, and I have quietly kept copies of both. Diplomacy is a matter of paperwork.
Let no one call this a defeat for anyone. It is a settlement, arranged over three dinners and one very patient council vote.

player_joined_my_faction.text: Welcome to {my_faction}, {player}. The council extends its warmest regards and its very long list of expectations.
{player} has sworn to {my_faction}. I trust they will find the council generous to those who serve it well.
{player}, I see you have sworn to {my_faction} at last. Do not imagine the council has forgotten the road you took to get here.
{player}, a warm welcome to {my_faction}. I have already placed your name beside three good committees, and I expect thanks.
Your oath is noted, {player}. {my_faction} is grateful, and the seating in the hall will prove most instructive.

player_left_my_faction.text: {player} has taken their oath to {faction}. I wish them every comfort in their new hall, and I shall keep their old chair warm.
So {player} has left {my_faction} for {faction}. Such a shame. I have already started the list of reasons the council will want.
{player}, I was sorry to see you go from {my_faction}. Was it the terms, or simply the company?
{player}, no hard feelings from me, and you may always return to {my_faction} once {faction} has tested your loyalty.
Your transfer to {faction} is recorded, {player}. I never hold a lord against his will, only against his better judgement.

player_granted_fief.text: {player} has been granted {fief}. A fine reward. I trust they will remember whose vote carried the motion.
{fief} has passed to {player}. The council is generous this season, and I have noted every hand that was raised.
{player} now holds {fief}. How charming. I shall try not to count how many committees it took to get them there.
{player}, congratulations on {fief}. Should you need a friendly voice in council, I would be honoured to speak for you.
{fief} to {player}, is it? I hope the walls hold better than the promises made to win it. Enjoy the view, all the same.

whisper_alliance_offer.text: {player}, {rival} has been quietly undermining us both, and {enemy_faction} would gladly pay for the favour. Shall we talk terms?
{player}, I have no wish to see {rival} hold a council seat much longer. Join me against {enemy_faction} and we shall share the credit.
{player}, a quiet understanding could do wonders. {rival} promises things they cannot deliver, and {enemy_faction} is ripe for taking.
{player}, between friends, {rival} is a liability to any honest lord. Let us stand together against {enemy_faction} before the next vote.
Ser {player}, I write with an offer. {enemy_faction} is weak at the border and {rival} is slow to act. Shall we split the spoils?

my_faction_took_fief.text: {fief} is ours. {my_faction} has taken it from {enemy_faction}, and the council will hear of it at great length.
The banners of {my_faction} now fly over {fief}. {enemy_faction} will want it back, and I intend to make them regret asking.
After a long siege, {fief} has fallen to {my_faction}. The terms were generous, though {enemy_faction} may dispute that.
Let it be recorded that {fief} now belongs to {my_faction}, taken from {enemy_faction} with almost no bloodshed. Almost.
{my_faction} holds {fief} at last. My thanks to every lord who answered the motion, and a quiet note for those who did not.

player_took_my_fief.text: {player} has taken {fief} from us. A bold move, and I am sure the council will want a full account of how it happened.
{fief} has changed hands, and {player} is now its master. I shall write the first letter of complaint before the ink is dry.
{player}, you have taken {fief}, which was mine in every way the council cares about. We shall discuss this properly before the vote.
{player}, {fief} is yours now, I suppose. Keep the gates shut and the rents honest, and we shall remain on civil terms.
Congratulations to {player} on {fief}. Such a clever way to lose a seat. I will keep the minutes of it in my own hand.

encounter_alliance_yes.text: Gladly, {player}. Let us put our seals to it before {enemy_faction} thinks to ask. And between us, do keep {rival} at arm's length.
An alliance, you say? I had hoped you would suggest it. We shall stand together against {enemy_faction}, and I shall tell {rival} nothing at all.
Yes, {player}, I accept. A written pact is better than a spoken one, and I will have the clerks draft it before supper.
Agreed, Ser {player}. I always prefer partners who keep their word, unlike certain lords I could name, though I will not name {rival} here.
You have my accord, {player}. Between the two of us and {enemy_faction}'s growing nerves, I expect this will be very profitable.

encounter_alliance_no.text: I am afraid not today, {player}. The council has not yet seen the terms, and I never sign what I have not read twice.
No, {player}, I think not. Your offer is generous, but {rival} would take it poorly, and I prefer my dinners uninterrupted.
Regretfully, I must refuse. Come back with something the council can actually vote on, {player}, and we shall see.
No, {player}. I do not trust a proposal that arrives on the road with no seal on it. Perhaps {rival} would be more pleased to accept.
Not this time, {player}, though I am flattered you thought of me. Let us keep our talks for the hall, where the walls are thicker.

ambient_chatter.text: Fog over the road to {town} again, which means the couriers will be late and the gossip will be early. Typical.
Someone please tell the lag gremlins that the council is in session and does not appreciate the delay in its own messages.
The harvest at {village} looks poor this year, and I expect the granary tithe to be the first motion of the season.
Rain on the market in {town}, and every lord sheltering under the same awning is suddenly very agreeable. Politics is weather, friends.
I have been asked three times today whether the road to {village} is safe. It is, mostly, and I am happy to say so in council.
